newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Taiwan vice-president on private visit to Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan vice-president on private visit to Dublin.

text.p: Lien Chan, vice-president and prime minister of Taiwan, made a private visit to Ireland on Friday but was not due to meet any Irish government ministers or officials.
Lien, who was granted a visa to be in Ireland in his capacity as a private citizen, was due to visit Trinity College Dublin to promote cultural exchanges between Ireland and Taiwan.

Irish media reported that the visit had drawn protests from Chinese government officials, who warned Dublin that Lien's trip could damage "the stable growth" of diplomatic links between China and Ireland.
China, which regards Taiwan as a renegade province, routinely protests to any state which gives entry visas to Taiwan ministers.
